instruction: Candid action photograph, low-angle medium shot. In an indoor judo dojo with a yellow tatami mat, the woman in the blue judo gi (R1) with her hair in a bun is pinning her opponent. She leans over the young man in the white judo gi (R2), wrapping her blue-sleeved arm tightly around his neck. The young man (R2) lies flat on his back on the mat, looking up with a calm, focused expression. Soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the contrast between the warm yellow mat and the cool blue gi.
